name: ZBD-04A
armament: 100 mm 2A70-type low-pressure gun/launcher (ZBD-04) or 30 mm cannon with HJ-73/ATGM
protection: Welded aluminium/steel hull with bolt-on appliqué armour on the 04A, rear troop door. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; frontal arc resists 12.7/14.5 mm; 7.62x54R damages optics, tyres/tracks and exposed gear, 12.7/14.5 mm penetrates side and rear; all launchers penetrate.
visual_notes: BMP-3-like turret (100 mm + 30 mm) on a longer, higher hull with a conventional front engine
Six/seven road wheels per side, slab appliqué armour panels on the hull sides of the 04A
Large rear ramp door; vision blocks along the troop compartment
Smoke grenade banks either side of the turret
